title: Kill switch
oneLiner: Stops your agent the moment something looks wrong: a transaction it didn't send, spending too fast, failing sends, or a drained wallet.
howItWorks: On every wake-up of the loop, reads the wallet's balance, Highwire's audit log, and the wallet's own recent transactions on-chain.
Stops the agent if the wallet signed a transaction Highwire didn't send: the sign that someone else may have the key.
Stops it too if it spends faster than max_sol_per_hour, sends fail over and over, the policy keeps refusing the agent's own calls, or the balance falls under a floor.
Stopping means creating the STOP file next to the wallet: Highwire then signs nothing, not a trade, claim, order fill or post.
It never deletes STOP. The user looks, then deletes it to resume, and the kill switch counts afresh from then.

notes.min_balance_sol: Stop if the wallet holds less than this. Set it under what the agent keeps on purpose.
notes.max_sol_per_hour: Stop if the agent sends more than this in an hour, counted from the audit log.
notes.max_failed_per_day: Stop after this many failed sends in a day.
notes.max_refused_per_hour: Stop after the policy refuses this many of the agent's own calls in an hour. The order runner's retries don't count.
notes.foreign_signatures: Stop if the wallet signed a transaction that isn't in the audit log.

wire: Call it first on every wake-up of the loop, inside a try/catch, and log its line when it changes.
If it returns stopped: true, skip the rest of that wake-up. Highwire would refuse everything anyway; skipping keeps the log quiet.
prompt: Read modules/kill-switch.md, then wire the kill-switch module into src/agent.ts as its "Wiring it in" section says. It needs nothing from the policy.
risks: It checks when the loop wakes, every few minutes: it limits damage, it doesn't prevent the first bad transaction. The policy's caps do that.
If someone else has the key, STOP only stops your agent, not them. Move what's left to a wallet only you control.
Signing with the same wallet in another app counts as a transaction Highwire didn't send. If that was you, delete STOP.
